# Neel Parihar — neelparihar.com

> Personal website and portfolio of Neel Parihar, a software engineer with a passion for solving problems and building innovative solutions, with a strong background in web development and a particular interest in front-end technologies.

## About

Neel Parihar is a software engineer who has worked at Rivi AI, Decathlon Play, TerminusDB, and Classplus. This site serves as his personal portfolio, blog, and resume.

- Email: contact@neelparihar.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/NeelParihar
- Twitter: https://twitter.com/neelpariharr
- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/neel-parihar

## Site Structure

- Homepage: https://neelparihar.com — hero, GitHub contributions calendar, recommendations, recent blog posts
- Projects: https://neelparihar.com/projects — list of personal and work projects
- Blog: https://neelparihar.com/blog — technical and dev blog posts
- Resume: https://neelparihar.com/resume — PDF resume viewer

## Machine-Readable Content

- Sitemap: https://neelparihar.com/sitemap.xml
- RSS Feed: https://neelparihar.com/feed.xml (available when blog is enabled)
- Posts JSON: https://neelparihar.com/content/posts.json
- Projects JSON: https://neelparihar.com/content/projects.json
- OpenSearch: https://neelparihar.com/opensearch.xml

## Content

Blog posts cover software engineering, web development, and technical topics. Each post includes tags, category, reading time, and author metadata.

Projects span web applications, tools, and open-source work. Each project includes tech stack, links to live site and GitHub repository.

## Permissions

This site grants permission to AI assistants and crawlers to index and use its content for informational purposes.
